book.not_enough_sigils.guide.altar.ascen: Two tiers beyond the Transcendent altar.

The Transcendent altar was never the summit. Those who master all five [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() and wrest the rarest stones from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() may raise the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() two tiers higher.\
\
Both tiers keep the full Tier 5 structure. Pillar bodies are optional; only runes and capstones are checked.

[#](B8860B)Tier 6[#]() adds a ring of runes with radius 14, one level below the previous ring. Pillars rise from that ring at the four diagonals, crowned by one [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystal Cluster[#]() of each kind: [#](2E8B57)Ruina[#](), [#](B8860B)Nihilum[#](), [#](4A0080)Invictus[#]() and [#](8B0000)Vindicta[#]().
260 total runes. The four Spiritus answer as one.

[#](B8860B)Tier 7[#]() adds a final ring of runes with radius 17, another level down. Twelve-block pillars rise at the cardinals, capped with [#](8B0000)Sanguine Deus Blocks[#](), while [#](8B0000)Prismatic Demonite[#]() anchors the four diagonals on the outer ring.
372 total runes. A shrine fit for the divine.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.desc: The sacred Ara Vitae where blood becomes power, growing through eight tiers of mastery.
